maison.equipment.title: My devices
maison.equipment.help: IPP: printer status and reported ink levels every 30 s. IGD: gateway Internet status every 10 s. These two devices remain read-only.
maison.equipment.empty: Add a printer or gateway through Configure. Local devices are only queried after your approval.
maison.equipment.unavailable_help: These readings do not establish the current state. Check that the engine and device are on, share a network, and the address, port and path are correct.
maison.equipment.meross_help: Read only. Consumption refers to the displayed date, not a lifetime total. Missing values are not zero.
maison.equipment.meross_unavailable: Reading not confirmed. Check the local address, stored key and plug connection; a different protocol may also be rejected.
maison.equipment.read_confirmed: Reading active: fresh response received, distinct from saved configuration.
maison.meross_manual.title: Manual controls — {name}
maison.meross_manual.limit: Your Meross settings, including the 30-minute limit if configured, remain unchanged. No Moli timer.
maison.meross_manual.pending: Checking target, sending command and reading back…
maison.meross_manual.confirmed: State confirmed by a local readback.
maison.meross_manual.unknown: State unconfirmed. Check the plug; no automatic retry.
maison.meross_manual.unavailable: Controls unavailable: check the engine, target and connection.
maison.meross_manual.readonly_help: To remove controls, stop the engine, uncheck this plug in My devices, save and restart. This does not turn the plug off.
maison.meross_manual.critical: Heating / critical use — manual commands only
maison.observation.title: Netatmo → Meross — heating
maison.observation.help: Observation reads Netatmo demand and simulates an intention without a physical order. Explicitly choose the thermostat and plug. Both integrations must be active for reading. A one-off real trial requires separate confirmation.
maison.observation.reason.none: Dry-run observation only: no physical state or heating is confirmed.
maison.observation.reason.unconfigured: Select a Netatmo source and Meross target to observe their link in dry-run mode.
maison.observation.reason.storage: The local selection cannot be saved or read. No existing file will be replaced.
maison.observation.reason.selection_chan: The selection changed. A new observation is needed; no previous intention is carried over.
maison.observation.reason.restarted: Resuming observation. Checking current states before simulating an intention.
maison.observation.reason.source_missing: The saved Netatmo source is unavailable in the engine.
maison.observation.reason.target_missing: The saved Meross plug is unavailable in the engine.
maison.observation.reason.identity: The model or identity does not match the selection. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.source_offline: The Netatmo source is offline. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.target_offline: The Meross plug is offline. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.driver_stopped: A selected driver is not running. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.source_unpubli: The Netatmo driver has not published new data since starting.
maison.observation.reason.invalid_demand: The published heating demand cannot be used. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.unknown_demand: Netatmo does not declare a known demand. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.missing_date: Collection time or validity duration is missing or invalid.
maison.observation.reason.future_date: A published timestamp is in the future. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.source_stale: The Netatmo source data is stale. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.target_stale: The Meross plug has no recent identity reading. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.coherence: States changed during observation. The result is discarded and will be read again.
maison.observation.reason.engine: The dry-run engine is unavailable. No intention.
maison.observation.reason.disconnected: The engine or devices are unavailable. No current intention.
maison.observation.reason.pending_select: The selection changed and has not been saved. No current intention.
maison.observation.reason.hidden: Observation is paused while this screen is hidden.
maison.observation.reason.transport: Observation or saving is unavailable. Refresh and check the selection.
maison.observation.reason.expired: This observation has expired. Refresh to check the source and plug.
maison.observation.real_title: Supervised real trial — one order only
maison.observation.autonomous_blocked: AUTOMATION DISABLED. No continuous automatic control: independent protections and failure behaviour still require qualification.
maison.observation.real_help: Demand is reported by Netatmo through its cloud, not proof of a flame. A trial applies that demand once to the selected plug. Installation and restart never start control.
maison.observation.physical_warning: Activation is blocked until every prerequisite is confirmed. Do not confirm an unknown item; have the installation checked by a professional. No work on 230 V terminals is requested.
maison.observation.vessel_pressure: Expansion vessel repaired or confirmed sound, boiler condition and pressure checked.
maison.observation.relay_enclosure: Finder 230 V relay insulation, enclosure and wiring checked.
maison.observation.thermostat_input: Finder contact compatibility with the boiler thermostat input checked.
maison.observation.loss_behavior: Relay and control behaviour on Wi-Fi, tablet and cloud loss checked.
maison.observation.supervised: I am present, understand the physical effect and have a safe manual stop for this one-off trial.
maison.observation.apply: Approve this version and apply once
maison.observation.cancel: Revoke / cancel — does not switch the plug off
maison.observation.stop_warning: Stopping Moli, leaving or revoking prevents a new order but does not switch off a plug already ON. An order already sent cannot be recalled. Moli cannot guarantee OFF with no network; check the real state and use your safe manual stop. The Meross 30 min timer is unchanged and is not a qualified independent safety protection. After the trial, manually switch off the selected plug from its card and verify OFF before ending supervision.
maison.observation.expired_trial: Preparation expired or data changed: read the states again before another voluntary trial.
maison.observation.trial_failure: Trial refused or state unconfirmed. Do not repeat clicks; check the plug and report. No automatic retry.
maison.observation.trial_confirmed: Meross state confirmed by a local readback. This does not confirm boiler heating. No automatic follow-up is active.
maison.observation.trial_cancelled: Cancellation requested. An in-flight order may already have been delivered. No OFF is sent; check the real state.
maison.observation.daily_lock: Real activation is unavailable in this release. Preparation creates a disabled native scenario, available for review and dry testing in Automations.
maison.observation.daily_loss: If the network or Moli stops, a powered plug may remain on. Stopping or revoking does not guarantee it switches off; retain manual OFF with readback.
